decisions.decision: Conform all renderers + CSS to the design-pack's canonical class names (.mission-card / .runway / .agents / .agent-lane / .telem / .telem-cell / .telem-spark / .scan-cell). My earlier invented names (.phase-runway / .telemetry-rail / .agent-lanes / .sparkline-channel) did not match the design-pack <style> block selectors so the components stacked unstyled. Operator caught this on 2026-05-25.

Replace sgsd-design-system.css with the full 73kB canonical CSS extracted verbatim from .planning/milestones/v3.4/design-pack/Cockpit.html <style>. SAC-required token aliases (--page, --surface) injected at top of :root. This is the single source of truth going forward; design-pack JSX is the visual reference, design-pack CSS is the styling reference.

render-html.cjs re-reads sgsd-design-system.css on every renderShell() call. Operator-edit visibility without server restart. Single ~25kB sync read per snapshot render is cheap and removes the stale-CSS surprise from P138.5.

Skip the design-pack outer <div class='stage'> grid container (which would impose a 2-column main+tape layout). Use simpler vertical-stacking <main class='sgsd-cockpit'> instead. Individual components retain their own grid layouts. Tape sidebar deferred to P142+.

Drop ExplanationBand as a separate component. The 'Why running' content lives inside MissionCard.mc-body in the canonical design pack; emitting both produced duplicate text. SAC-P139-01 renderer list updated to drop renderExplanationBand and add renderTelemCell + renderSparkSvg.

STATE.md frontmatter rarely has a `phase:` key in practice. run() now derives phase via: (1) options.phase, (2) frontmatter `phase:`/`active_phase:`/`current_phase:`, (3) status text regex `P<NN> PENDING/ACTIVE`, (4) max P number in status text, (5) newest phases/ subdir name. Resolves real phase_dir by scanning for `{phase}-` prefix.

attachPipeline forward-fills stage status: a later-stage artifact implies all earlier stages done. Active = first non-done after rightmost done. Avoids the 'plan done but research and vtp-enrich still pending' visual gap when Claude writes plan directly without research/vtp-enrich artifacts.
